answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ledge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The meadow lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the island is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length.
